examined_formations.title: CHINA_SHENZHEN_6_FTE_ECOMMERCE_OPERATOR_WITH_POSITIVE_REVENUE_BUT_NET_LOSS_NEGATIVE_OCF_AND_PHYSICAL_SELF_OPERATION
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: The 2026 H1 report directly discloses 6 employees at period end.
The same current report records attributable net loss RMB328,028.67 and operating cashflow negative RMB116,902.77.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Current total assets are RMB1,818,571.03 and current equity is only RMB93,811.83.
The company operates e-commerce agency services plus self-operated merchandise activity.
Self-operated activity explicitly includes procurement, production, warehousing, shipping, returns and after-sales.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Current revenue remains positive but is down year over year.
The company has accumulated losses and current operating cashflow remains negative.
Management discloses material going-concern uncertainty and reliance on controlling-party funding support if operating funds become difficult.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Six employees prove very low headcount can coexist with a real customer revenue stream.
The same packet fails both positive-net-profit and positive-OCF gates, so low labor does not establish founder-light cashflow.
Physical self-operation and consulting/training elements would also remain direct delivery inputs even if economics later improved.
economic_signal: Current 2026 H1: 6 FTE; revenue RMB141,509.43; attributable net loss RMB328,028.67; OCF negative RMB116,902.77.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The current economics hard gate fails before control-history deepening.
No control transfer, scarcity or machine-control claim is promoted from a loss-making cash-burning packet.
Physical procurement/production/warehousing/shipping/returns/after-sales are preserved as real operating inputs rather than normalized away.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_BEIJING_20_FTE_SYSTEM_INTEGRATOR_WITH_POSITIVE_REVENUE_AND_POSITIVE_OCF_BUT_CURRENT_NET_LOSS
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: The 2026 H1 report directly discloses 20 employees at period end, up from 19.
Current revenue is RMB8,954,007.84, up 90.71% year over year.
Current operating cashflow is positive RMB2,132,609.70, while current net profit remains negative RMB878,305.63.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The company provides data-management software/hardware products, cloud services and integrated solutions to government/enterprise and industry-integrator customers.
Current inventory is RMB7,836,926.10 and short-term borrowings are RMB4,700,000.00.
System-integration revenue expanded materially during H1.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The report attributes current revenue growth to increased system-integration orders.
Positive OCF is attributed mainly to increased advance receipts under sales contracts.
The same period still produces a net loss and a 15.05% gross margin, so cash collection timing cannot substitute for profitability.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Positive revenue and positive OCF can coexist with a current net loss in a small software/system-integration organization.
Advance-payment-driven OCF is real cashflow but does not satisfy the positive-profit gate.
System integration, software/hardware delivery and customer-specific solution work remain direct operating inputs.
economic_signal: Current 2026 H1: 20 FTE; revenue RMB8,954,007.84; net loss RMB878,305.63; OCF positive RMB2,132,609.70.
Current inventory RMB7,836,926.10 and short-term borrowings RMB4,700,000.00.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The current economics gate stops before controller-history research because net profit is negative.
Positive OCF is not promoted as normalized cash profitability when the report attributes the increase mainly to customer advances.
No specialized machine-control asset is inferred from generic system-integration capability.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_SICHUAN_16_FTE_SEED_COMPANY_WITH_POSITIVE_REVENUE_POSITIVE_PROFIT_BUT_NEGATIVE_OCF_AND_PHYSICAL_PRODUCTION_FLOW
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: The 2026 H1 report directly discloses 16 employees at period end.
Current revenue is RMB11,335,117.86 and attributable net profit is positive RMB528,888.03.
Current operating cashflow is negative RMB711,001.01.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: Current total assets are RMB71,079,588.06 and liabilities RMB32,436,409.92.
The company produces and sells corn, rice, rapeseed and wheat seed products.
Current balance sheet includes material receivables, seed-related intangible/development assets and production/sales operating flow.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Current revenue grew 4.13% and gross margin is 29.22%.
Attributable net profit remains positive while operating cashflow remains negative.
The report attributes the OCF improvement versus prior year to reduced external payments, but the cashflow is still below zero.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: This packet passes current low headcount, external revenue and positive profit but fails the independent positive-OCF gate.
A profitable accounting period therefore does not prove positive operating cash conversion.
Agricultural seed production and sales are physical production/inventory/distribution flows and would remain outside a machine-only control thesis even if OCF turned positive.
economic_signal: Current 2026 H1: 16 FTE; revenue RMB11,335,117.86; attributable net profit RMB528,888.03; OCF negative RMB711,001.01.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The economics hard gate fails on operating cashflow before control-history deepening.
No favorable parent-company OCF is substituted for the negative consolidated OCF.
Physical seed production and distribution are preserved as direct operating reality.

excluded_observations: Scan 060-120 formations and their primary discovery signals were excluded from Scan 121 primary formation selection.
Shangyang Information was not promoted after the early gate because current 11-FTE reporting still showed a net loss and negative operating cashflow.

Other current-report entities with positive revenue, profit and OCF were not treated as low-FTE candidates when disclosed staffing was materially larger; positive economics does not justify relaxing the labor floor.
No acquisition/control-history deepening was performed for the three primary Scan 121 formations because each failed at least one current economic hard gate.
No job, gig, RFQ, procurement or asset-marketplace feed was used as the discovery ontology.
